") == "a b" + assert sanitize_html('t') == "t" + assert sanitize_html("plain 1 < 2") == "plain 1 < 2" diff --git a/textkit/__init__.py b/textkit/__init__.py index 6e547d8..a2d610c 100644 --- a/textkit/__init__.py +++ b/textkit/__init__.py @@ -1,4 +1,4 @@ """Small text helpers.""" -from .core import count_words, slug, title_case, truncate, wrap +from .core import count_words, sanitize_html, slug, title_case, truncate, wrap -__all__ = ["count_words", "slug", "title_case", "truncate", "wrap"] +__all__ = ["count_words", "sanitize_html", "slug", "title_case", "truncate", "wrap"] diff --git a/textkit/core.py b/textkit/core.py index 766a06c..636cfd6 100644 --- a/textkit/core.py +++ b/textkit/core.py @@ -2,6 +2,7 @@ import re import textwrap _NON_WORD = re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+") +_TAG = re.compile(r"<(/?)([A-Za-z][^<>]*)?>|", re.DOTALL) def slug(text: str) -> str: @@ -25,3 +26,13 @@ def title_case(text: str) -> str: def count_words(text: str) -> int: return len(text.split()) + + +def sanitize_html(text: str) -> str: + """Keep bare and tags, drop every other tag but keep its text.""" + + def keep(m: re.Match) -> str: + name = (m.group(2) or "").strip().lower() + return m.group(0).lower() if name in ("b", "i") else "" + + return _TAG.sub(keep, text)
